title: F6 A/B Corpus Diff Label
description: Ground-truth label for one diff in the F6 A/B corpus. One file per diff at labels/<diff_id>.json.

diff_id.description: Stable identifier — kebab-case, prefix d##- where ## is 01..30 in manifest order.

sha.description: Full git SHA the diff was extracted from. The manifest references this; harness uses git show to materialize.

summary.description: First-line commit message, for human readability.

domain_hints.description: Project domain(s) per flux-drive Step 1.0.1. Used to validate domain classification and as a triage feature.

expected_agents.description: Agents that MUST fire for this diff (precision floor for the system under test). Missing any of these is a recall miss.

expected_findings_themes.description: Short prose themes a thorough review SHOULD surface. Used as the ground truth for the primary metric (review-coverage-per-diff).

rationale.description: 1–3 sentences explaining the label, especially the non-obvious agent choices.

complexity.description: Matches flux-drive Step 1.1 Diff Profile complexity. small <200 lines, medium 200–1000, large >=1000 (slicing-eligible).

discriminating.description: True if legacy and ontology backends are expected to disagree on agent selection. Drives subset analysis in the F6b ship-decision memo.

labeler.description: Identifier of the human or model that produced the label.

labeler_notes.description: Free-form notes — uncertainty flags, edge-case rationale, follow-ups.

human_validated.description: True after a second-labeler review pass; false on V1 single-labeler set.

label_version.description: Semver. v1.0.0 is the F6a ship state. Bump on relabel.
